live.note: Floor of four observed live runs, not a target. Measured scenarios_passed across runs: 24 and 21 at ebe1603, then 21 and 19 at 739a68c. Contract rate ranged 1.0 to 0.8511. Only scout.resume-partial-sweep failed in every run; the rest of the failure set changed run to run, so live scoring is dominated by agent nondeterminism rather than by skill quality. The baseline is therefore set to the lowest observed run so the guard flags a genuine collapse instead of ordinary variance. Treat live as advisory and confirm any live movement over at least two runs. The deterministic plumbing baseline is the strict guard.
